faqs.q: What is the minimum contract length for a private office?
faqs.a: We offer flexible terms starting from one month. Longer commitments (3, 6, or 12 months) come with preferential pricing.

faqs.q: Can I use the workspace address for my commercial registration (CR)?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Virtual Office and Private Office packages include a valid Riyadh address that can be used for your commercial registration with MISA and the Ministry of Commerce.
Yes, dedicated parking spaces are available in the building's basement car park for private office members. Co-working members receive discounted validation.

faqs.q: Do you provide IT support on-site?
faqs.a: Our in-house IT team handles network issues, printer setup, and device connectivity during business hours. After-hours support is available for private office members.
